name: Joel Myers
life: “I still remember a regular fading from our calendar one appointment at a time.” Saturday often includes a stop at Paper & Pine Books, where Joel starts with the handwritten shelf cards and often leaves with a suggestion for somebody else.
voice: I cover the reception desk. I can tell from cancellations which technicians lose the same customers every summer.
appearance: Joel has a smooth side part with one rebellious curl, a strong profile and a little space between the front teeth, and a favorite piece of clothing, a soft blue checked shirt. It usually goes with a train token tied to a zipper pull. When somebody else has the floor, Joel looks toward the door whenever a name is called.
personality: Joel takes a rejection personally for a day and analytically on the second morning. Joel can be generous with a rival once the first night's sleep has intervened.
agenda: To show the technicians their own seasonal cancellation patterns.
family: Tom Clement is Joel’s half-sibling. Joel keeps the photographs. Tom knows which ones can be shared. They enjoy remembering people in public and also know what it feels like to have a private afternoon turned into an anecdote for strangers. Asked about *The first delivery fee*, Tom says, “I can deliver on foot as far as the park. A hot lunch becomes a cold one exactly halfway across it.”
connections: Levi Lau. A receptionist can name the seasonal gaps while a driver can show the worker another chair.
